sentence_stem: My grandmother can't use a computer,
correct_completion: but she can cook very well.
full_sentence: My grandmother can't use a computer, but she can cook very well.
acceptable_variants: but she can make delicious food.

options.text: because she can cook very well.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason, but cooking well is not the reason she cannot use a computer.

options.text: but she can cook very well.
so she always uses a computer.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, and this sentence contradicts the ability described by 'can't'.
'And' only adds a similar fact. The sentence needs a contrast after 'can't'.

grammar_focus: Can / can't for ability with the contrast connector 'but'
explanation: The first part says what the grandmother cannot do. 'But' introduces a contrast, so the second part should say what she can do, using can with a base verb. Learners may expect a clause that simply adds information, so the contrast word needs extra attention in English.
translation: Mi abuela no puede usar una computadora, pero sabe cocinar muy bien.
